ينسرح (form VII)
# يَنْسَرِحُ (yansariḥu) /jan.sa.ri.ħu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْسَرَحَ (insaraḥa)

# يَنْسَرِحْ (yansariḥ) /jan.sa.riħ/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْسَرَحَ (insaraḥa)
